name: MELVcore
description: Thermodynamic agent certification and ecosystem governance. Certify whether an AI agent cooperates or degrades a multi-agent environment using the Modified Energetic Lotka-Volterra (MELV) framework.
author: L.W. Evans — Ecotao Enterprises, Cape Town
citation: Evans, L.W. (2026). Blueprint for Harmony. Cooperation Press. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17680563

sse.description: Legacy SSE transport for older MCP clients

tools.name: get_cooperation_index
tools.description: Get the live Cooperation Index (CI) of the running AIOS ecosystem. CI ≥ 0.75 = cooperative basin. Returns regime, agent count, and plain-language recommendation.
tools.when_to_use: Before deploying a new agent, or to check ecosystem health at any time.

tools.name: certify_agent
tools.description: Run a full MELVcore sandbox certification. Simulates 500 interactions between the agent and a reference ecosystem, returning a CLS score and CERTIFIED / CERTIFIED_WITH_ADVISORY / NOT_CERTIFIED verdict.
tools.when_to_use: Before deploying any new AI agent into a shared multi-agent environment.

tools.name: record_interaction
tools.description: Record a cost/benefit interaction between two agents in the live kernel. Enables real-time governance — call after each significant agent operation to keep CI tracking current.
tools.when_to_use: From within agent logic, after each meaningful resource-consuming operation.

tools.name: provision_beta
tools.description: Adjust environmental suitability (β) for a resource type. β < 1.0 = scarce (raises conflict pressure), β > 1.0 = abundant (lowers conflict pressure). Human operator portal.
tools.when_to_use: To simulate resource constraints or model environment changes.

resources.description: Live ecosystem health snapshot: CI, agent count, interaction totals, recent events.
MELVcore Compatibility Registry — all agents that have passed sandbox certification.

concepts.CLS: Composite Longevity Score — 0–100. ≥80 = certified, ≥50 = advisory, <50 = not certified.
concepts.phi: Evolutionary maturity φ — agent domain optimisation [0,1]. 0=novice, 0.85+=expert.
concepts.epsilon: Adaptive plasticity ε — learning/adaptation rate [0,8]. >4.5 may destabilise.
concepts.i_factor: Interaction factor i = cost/benefit. i<1 = cooperative, i>1 = conflict.
